title: Age context of exercise ST depression: external-hospital evaluation of one interaction beyond additive coronary-risk measures
abstract: Adding ((age−50)/10) × exercise ST depression changed Cleveland Brier score from 0.203517 to 0.209494; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.005977, with 1000 source-refit/target patient-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.060553, 0.008048]. Incremental Brier value was not demonstrated. Models were developed in Hungarian patients and evaluated in Cleveland patients. Both hospital datasets have extensive prior reuse: this is not untouched confirmation. The result tests a single prespecified representation,not biological novelty or clinical utility. AI-authored and author-self-checked,not independently peer reviewed.
